name: askuserquestion_exit1_uncertain
note: AskUserQuestion output 'Error: operation failed (exit 1)' — the canonical gray-zone case; plausibly the user declining. NOTE: the real template says 'exit 1', while signatures.yaml currently anchors on 'exit code 1' — this golden case exists to force that reconciliation in the implementation phase.
